title: Convalescent Snakes & Ladders — controls
lines: This board isn't meant to be efficient or strategic. It's meant to feel like recovery.
Sometimes progress reverses or stalls without warning. That is intentional.
The goal is not victory. The goal is experience.
M   :  opens a window with the current square's text enlarged
Snakes & Ladder squares:  hidden until you land on them, outcome is uncertain.
Hospital pull:  sometimes you are snapped back to the hospital square for a clinic visit.
Recall:  if you have to visit the hospital, press R within a few seconds to return to your most recent square.
